title: Capstone: A Mart for the Sales Cube
description: Capstone: a sales-by-rep star schema with a type 2 sales rep dimension, a fact load, an aggregate table, a nightly job on the Pentaho Server that refreshes the cube, and a Mondrian schema on the mart.

checks.label: Your job runs your transformations (load_sales_rep_mart.kjb has a Transformation entry)
Your job refreshes the cube (load_sales_rep_mart.kjb has an HTTP entry)
Your Mondrian schema declares an aggregate table (sales_rep_mart.xml has an AggName)
Your job wrote its load audit (load_audit.csv in out\)
Your README.md in solution\ (how to run, schedule and check the load)
